raw.description: Potential for reflected XSS due to direct insertion of user-controlled data into the DOM without sanitization.
raw.exploit: An attacker could manipulate the profile data to include malicious scripts that would execute in the victim's browser.

raw.description: CSRF vulnerability due to lack of CSRF protection on state-changing requests.
raw.exploit: An attacker could trick a user into making unwanted requests to change their profile information.

raw.description: JWT secret is loaded from environment variables but not validated for strength or rotation.
raw.exploit: If the JWT secret is weak or leaked, an attacker could forge tokens to impersonate users.

raw.description: Potential for hardcoded secrets if environment variables are not properly managed.
raw.exploit: An attacker with access to the source code or environment could discover sensitive information.

raw.description: Lack of access control checks on the /api/profile endpoint for updating user information.
raw.exploit: An authenticated user could update another user's profile information if they manipulate the request.

raw.description: Lack of HTTPS enforcement for secure cookie transmission.
raw.exploit: An attacker could intercept cookies over an insecure connection if HTTPS is not enforced.
